policy._maxOrderUsdNote: Optional hard dollar cap per buy. null lets policy.sizing govern. Set a small number like 2 for your first live trade, then remove it.

sizing._note: Sizing is a share of the whole book. The model states a target weight per name; the engine adds toward it in steps of at most maxOrderPercent per cycle, never above maxPositionPercent in one name. maxTotalExposureUsd still caps the whole book.

research._note: The review is the only thing that costs money. intervalSeconds applies in regular hours, Extended in pre/after-hours, Closed overnight and weekends. With skipIfNothingNew the model is only called when the inputs changed since the last review (new filing, headline, note, cash, or a holding moving materialMovePercent). maxCandidatesPerCycle and maxSearchesPerCycle bound the bill per review.

claimable._note: Copy the creator-claimable view signature from the verified locker source on Blockscout. Not in pons docs. Leave null and the loop falls back to detecting WETH pons auto-routes to your payout wallet.

claim._note: Copy the claim function signature from the verified locker source on Blockscout. The loop refuses to claim until this is set.

uniswap._note: Set to "SwapRouter" or "SwapRouter02" after checking the verified source at robinhoodchain.blockscout.com/address/0xCaf681a66D020601342297493863E78C959E5cb2. The signer refuses every swap until this is set.

execution._tickNote: Quote cadence by session. The stop loss and the dashboard repricer run every tick; slowing ticks off-hours cuts the catalog quoting from 275k requests a day to about 60k.
execution._cashNote: The book's cash is USDG: stock tokens trade against USDG on Robinhood Chain, not WETH. The trading half of each fee claim is swapped WETH->USDG once (cashSlippageBps), then every buy is USDG->stock and every sell is stock->USDG. gasReserveEth: the runner warns when native ETH falls below this.

runtime._note: watchAddress: your operator wallet, for preview mode observation. There is no watchlist: the agent watches the entire catalog.

site.credit: Launched on Pons, built by Ozzy (MeadGod)
site._repriceNote: How often open positions are re-marked and data.json re-exported. Each export is pushed to the page instantly over /events. Independent of the trading tick.

push._note: Pushes data.json and history.json to Vercel Blob when they change, so the static site at zzy.live updates on its own. Needs BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN in .env. Worst-case staleness is cacheSeconds plus the page poll.

exitPolicy._note: Deterministic guards only. Exit judgement is the allocator's (see research). maxLossPercent is the hard stop; the tranche band clamps how much of a position one TRIM may sell.

decisions._note: Public decision log, one file per name per review. The site reads this.

notebook._note: What the agent is tracking between reviews: names it is waiting on and what it is waiting for. Noted names reach the shortlist without needing a price move first. Entries expire.

earnings._note: Nasdaq earnings calendar, fetched one request per day in the window, cached on disk. Names reporting inside policy.earningsBlackoutDays are dropped before research; every holding and candidate carries its next report date into the review.

social.creator: Ozzy, also known as MeadGod, the creator of Pons
social._note: ZZY's own X account. Anything that actually happened posts as soon as it happened: a settled buy, sale, rotation, or fee claim. No gap, no daily cap on real events; safetyCapPerDay only stops a bug from becoming a hundred tweets. Soft posts (review notes, thoughts from the notebook) go out at most every softEveryHours when nothing real has been said. One state-of-the-book post a day at dailyReportHourUtc. enabled false = dry-run. Credentials in .env. Never posts from paper or fork.

history._note: PnL time series behind the dashboard chart. live = the last liveMax exports inside data.json; archive = one point per minute for archiveDays, served as site/history.json.
